cases.instruction: Open the page. Return its main heading as heading, every list item as items, and the main element's data-checksum attribute as checksum. Answer with one JSON object.
Open the page, follow the canonical record link, then return the destination record identifier as recordId and its output value as value. Answer with one JSON object.
Open the page, enter the requested input value in the benchmark field, submit the form, then return submitted as a boolean and the displayed submitted value as value. Answer with one JSON object.
Open the page, wait until the dynamic output stops saying pending, then return its final text as message. Answer with one JSON object.
Open the page. Count all body rows as rowCount and sum their numeric index cells as indexChecksum. Return both numbers. Answer with one JSON object.
